answer: Sybil resistance follows from an EigenTrust-style trust matrix: reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so identities need sustained honest service to retain influence. A freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality without trusted reciprocal paths; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot amplify unsupported claims, and consensus thresholds reject it. Like nectar crossing a canyon, trust needs a trellis of credible links, not merely many new names.
